# Sub-JEPA: Subspace Gaussian Regularization for Stable End-to-End World Models Official implementation of the paper: **Sub-JEPA: Subspace Gaussian Regularization for Stable End-to-End World Models**. [ ](https://kaizhao.net/sub-jepa) [ ](https://github.com/intcomp/Sub-JEPA) [ ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09241) [ ](https://huggingface.co/intcomp/sub-jepa) --- ## Overview Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer an effective framework for learning world models, but without sufficient constraints, their representation spaces can easily collapse. While recent methods like LeWM prevent this by enforcing a strong isotropic Gaussian prior in the high-dimensional ambient space, this can introduce an overly strong structural bias. **Sub-JEPA** relaxes this global constraint by applying Gaussian regularization across multiple random subspaces instead of the original embedding space. ## Main Result Sub-JEPA consistently improves over LeWM across four continuous-control environments. | Method | Two-Room | Reacher | PushT | OGB-Cube | | -------- | ---------------: | ---------------: | ---------------: | ---------------: | | LeWM | 84.33 ± 4.23 | 82.67 ± 4.42 | 84.67 ± 6.53 | 67.33 ± 5.01 | | Sub-JEPA | **95.00 ± 2.76** | **84.00 ± 4.00** | **89.00 ± 5.33** | **76.33 ± 5.99** | --- ## Repository Layout ## Installation ### 1. Clone the repository If you forgot `--recursive`, you can run: ### 2. Set up the environment + data (same as LeWM) Follow the upstream LeWM instructions: - Installation: https://github.com/lucas-maes/le-wm#using-the-code - Data layout: https://github.com/lucas-maes/le-wm#data In particular, LeWM (and this repo) expects datasets and checkpoints under `$STABLEWM_HOME` (defaults to `~/.stable-wm/`). ## Pretrained Checkpoints We provide pretrained Sub-JEPA checkpoints on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/intcomp/sub-jepa). abstract_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）为学习世界模型提供了有效框架，但缺乏足够约束时，其表示空间容易坍塌。近期方法如LeWM通过在高维环境空间中施加强各向同性高斯先验来防止坍塌，但这可能引入过强的结构偏差。Sub-JEPA通过将高斯正则化应用于多个随机子空间而非原始嵌入空间，从而放松了全局约束。实验表明，Sub-JEPA在四个连续控制环境中一致优于LeWM。
tldr_zh: Sub-JEPA通过子空间高斯正则化稳定世界模型训练，性能超越LeWM。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：Sub-JEPA在多个随机子空间上施加高斯正则化，而不是原始嵌入空间，从而放松全局约束。


# 一、动机

> 现有方法LeWM通过施加强各向同性高斯先验防止表示空间崩溃，但引入了过强的结构偏差。Sub-JEPA通过子空间高斯正则化缓解这一问题。


# 二、方法

> Sub-JEPA在多个随机子空间上施加高斯正则化，而不是原始嵌入空间，从而放松全局约束。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在四个连续控制环境上，Sub-JEPA一致优于LeWM：Two-Room 95.00±2.76 vs 84.33±4.23，Reacher 84.00±4.00 vs 82.67±4.42，PushT 89.00±5.33 vs 84.67±6.53，OGB-Cube 76.33±5.99 vs 67.33±5.01。


# 四、对我的启发

> 该方法展示了在保持表示多样性的同时防止空间崩溃的有效性，与机器人控制任务相关。
